name: masterdata-api
description: Token-authenticated REST API client skill for any deployed Master Data Services (MDS) instance - discover/manage models, entities and attributes, stage records with attribute-value filtering, and read deployed master data and views (with field selection and unique-value/distinct lookups for cascading dropdown filters), attribute ordering, dropdown labels, cascading reference dropdowns, per-model/entity access control (Entra groups) and cross-model reference lookups. Independent of any specific dbt project or checkout.
